what: sim-test-3: the decisions of the replicated log's client rules (mongo-server/src/locallog.rs) on ctl test_91's order, which the simulator ports (src/fx/sim/cluster/ext3.rs). The real engine (ctl-tests/test_95_sim_log_conformance.py) and the simulator's story (fx::sim::tests::sim_story_log_takeover_retry) are both checked against this table: a port that drifts from the code fails one of them.
order: B holds the database; W0 acknowledged and uploaded
B's WAL uploads held; W1 acknowledged (in the log only)
A restarts: reads the log back; its replay is refused by B's lease; A stops at hold_kept_records
B's upload of W1 goes through (the log told its position); B's uploads held again
A keeps its records and its retry runs (W1 is in the store)
B is killed before W2's upload; A takes the database over

decisions.restart_read_kept: A's restart read the records of W1 back from the log
decisions.replay_refused_by_lease: A's replay was refused because B holds the database's lease (before A took it)
decisions.kept_copies_in_log: A wrote copies of its kept records to the log (at new positions)
decisions.retry_confirms_read_pos: A's retry, not the lease holder, told the log only the highest position it read at its start
decisions.retry_done: A's retry found its kept records stored and ended
decisions.takeover_applies_w2: A's takeover read W2 back from the log and applied it
decisions.w2_lost: acknowledged writes of W2 are missing after the takeover
